questions.question: What is the first step when you notice a serious hazard on a masonry job site?
options: Report it to the supervisor immediately
Move the hazard without telling anyone
questions.explanation: Serious hazards must be reported immediately so they can be controlled before someone is injured.

questions.category: A2 - Apply OHS Regulations and WorkSafeBC Standards
questions.question: Why must workers follow WorkSafeBC regulations?
options: They help prevent workplace injury and illness
questions.explanation: WorkSafeBC regulations are designed to protect workers from unsafe conditions.

questions.category: A3 - Use Fall Protection Systems and Equipment
questions.question: At heights, fall protection is used mainly to prevent what?
questions.explanation: Fall protection protects workers from injury or death caused by falls.

questions.question: Which PPE protects the eyes from flying chips while cutting brick?
questions.explanation: Eye protection prevents flying particles from injuring the eyes.

questions.question: Which fire extinguisher class is commonly used for ordinary combustibles such as wood and paper?
questions.explanation: Class A extinguishers are used on ordinary combustible materials.
